title: Germany could generate over 600,000 tonnes of PV module waste by 2030
summary: A Fraunhofer CSP study estimates that Germany’s installed PV modules contain 5.35 million tonnes of materials worth billions of euros, highlighting significant recycling potential. More than 600,000 tonnes of PV waste could arise by 2030, but uncertain return volumes may create temporary overcapacity in Germany’s expanding recycling sector. The post Germany could generate over 600,000 tonnes of PV module waste by 2030 appeared first on pv magazine Global .
